reason: B is the stronger proposal because solutionizing followed by aging provides a more controlled route to fine coherent precipitates, includes ductility as a possible trade-off, and better aligns the aging and test-temperature ranges than A, whose 600°C precipitates may coarsen or dissolve during testing at 700–800°C. Both remain weakened by an unspecified alloy composition and phase chemistry, no supporting evidence, and failure to establish that a stable coherent intermetallic can actually form in the stated composition range.
